description.p: Bengal Download Manager is a lightweight, open-source download manager. It features multi-threaded segment acceleration, browser extension integration, proxy support, and category organization.

ul.li: Fixed media downloads that could get stuck and never finish
Fixed download cancel showing the wrong status in the progress window
Aria2: Cancel download on stop instead of pausing
UI Stop and Stop All buttons now pause downloads instead of cancelling them, so downloads can be resumed later
Aria2 pause/resume/speed-limit calls are now resilient to a missing Aria2 engine
Download store keys are now stable across application restarts
Force Fusion widget style to prevent Breeze scrollbars in Flatpak on KDE
Fixed downloads sometimes appearing complete before the file was actually downloaded
Starting a download while background prefetching is still in progress now resumes the file correctly
Fixed Start minimized in system tray not working in the Flatpak build
Fixed the autostart option being silently disabled after upgrading
Autostart and start-minimized preferences are now saved and stay in sync
Turning off autostart now also clears the start-minimized option
Existing Flatpak autostart entries are repaired automatically after updating
The main window now reappears automatically when no system tray is available
The tray menu correctly switches between Show and Hide
Previous release notes are preserved in the app catalog
Running from source now reports the correct project version
Revert to PNG screenshots for AppStream catalog compatibility
Update summary to High speed downloader
Metainfo and catalog improvements
Added official Flathub banner branding metadata with custom light and dark themes
Configured muted sage and deep pine brand styling for Flathub carousel and headers

Added official Flathub integration and badges
Updated translation catalogs
